supplemental.method: Orchestrator supplemental measurement 2026-10-15 (Pillow/numpy). 'core' = pixels with alpha>=200; luminance = WCAG/sRGB relative luminance (channel linearisation, Rec.709 weights) averaged over core pixels; hue = HSV hue (degrees) of the core mean RGB. Independent of vision judgement. Same environment as main audit. Two luminance definitions are reported per asset: 'relative_luminance' = luminance of the core mean RGB; 'core_lum_perpixel_mean' = mean of per-pixel relative luminance over core pixels (alpha>=200). Fill percentages elsewhere in this audit are bbox-fill (silhouette bounding-box side / canvas side); alpha>=128 pixel-area fractions are in files/<name>/silhouette/area_fraction.
